snippet.title: F355 Challenge 2: International Course Edition Arcade
snippet.description:
The racing simulator "F355 challenge 2" is realized with the partnership of Ferrari like his prequel.
Furthermore, they have added five New world popular courses:
FIORANO, LAGUNA-SECA, SEPANG, NURBURGRING and ATLANTA in addition to the previous MONZA, SUGO, SUZUKA and Long Beach. New courses have unique features individually such as slope, bank and so on. For a total of 9 courses.

Other small improvements:
Al Artificial Intelligence, new enemy cars are smarter (which makes the game harder)
Assist Functions are better and more functional then F355-1.
Thanks to that,it's now easier for beginners have fun while improving their skills with 6 gear stick-shift and a clutch (Dix cabinet).
Driving data printouts are available Dlx Model only,you can check your driving line and lap time on the racetrack, as well as engine RPMs, speedand gear over all sections. By comparing your data with other drivers, you can check how well you did and prepare for the next race.
